Internal: a model's coefficient rows made ready to print

Source: R/models.R
dot-jst_coef_display.Rd

Under variable.id = "labels" the rows are relabeled; the categorical predictors' dummy rows are grouped under their variable (.jst_collect_multicat_regs(), .jst_group_dummy_coefs()). jlm() and jlogistic() each held this block (Session 386, the twin build).

Usage

.jst_coef_display(
  out_coefs,
  vlmode,
  lab_src,
  formula,
  dummy_regs,
  auto_cat_regs,
  dummy_coef_names,
  value_mode_coef,
  show_ref_categories
)

Arguments

out_coefs

The formatted coefficient table.

vlmode, lab_src, formula

The variable-id mode, the label source and the formula.

dummy_regs, auto_cat_regs, dummy_coef_names

The registrations.

value_mode_coef, show_ref_categories

The display settings.

Value

list(coef_disp, multi_cat_regs).
